content:
**BlamCo Brand Mac and Cheese** is a food item in *Fallout 76*.

A box of BlamCo brand macaroni and cheese. The box design shows a picture of a bomb inside a bowl of mac and cheese. The box itself has a dispenser on the side so the product can be easily poured out into a container. Most of the boxes found in Appalachia are the dirty variant and have absorbed some radiation over the years since they were produced. Both types restore a small amount of HP and satisfy a moderate amount of hunger. The dirty variant also gives a negligible dose of rads.

- The dirty, irradiated variant can be found in the following locations:
 - Two in a rowboat in the river just south of Grafton Dam.
 - Two in the Shelters Claim Center.
 - One in the Eta Psi House.
 - One in Watoga Underground near the end in the diner storeroom behind a level 0 locked door.
 - One on the body of Willie.
 - All other mapped locations have a 25% chance to spawn.
- The clean, non-irradiated variant can be found in the following locations:
 - Can be produced at the Sunshine Meadows Industrial Farm after the food packaging factory has been powered up and the appropriate terminal entry selected.
 - May be bought from Mr Waiter and Ms Waitress at the dining room inside the Whitespring Resort.
 - Chance to be found in Secure Transport Container.
 - Chance to be sold by the MODUS production terminal.
